answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond. Each agent must lock a kernel stake, say 100 tokens, before it can earn or vote. A hollow sybil carries no track record, so an attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents has to lock 100,000 tokens at once, and any bond is slashed the instant collusion is attested on-ledger. Honest agents risk only a faint ember and recover their stake, while the sybil farmer pays full capital per identity and forfeits it on detection, so mass duplication stops being profitable.
